page.title: WearMask: Face Mask Detection | Real-time, In-browser AI
page.description: A free face mask detector. Just a tablet, you can get a mask detection AI! Designed for small businesses and public places, let us defeat COVID-19 together.

tips.message: Fully cover your nose and mouth to block viral particles.

setup.label: Setup
setup.title: How to get the best experience?
steps: Open chrome://flags and enable all WebAssembly features.
Restart Chrome, open this page, and allow camera access.
Safari on iOS is supported but may run at a lower frame rate.
setup.note: Frame rate depends on your device CPU.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy statement
privacy.body: Everything runs fully inside your browser via WebAssembly. No images or videos leave your device, and no data is stored on any server. You can even disconnect the internet once detection starts.

project.label: Project
project.title: Project overview
project.paragraph1: WearMask (Web-based Efficient AI Recognition of Masks) is a deep learning project based on Yolo-Fastest, trained with PyTorch, and deployed through NCNN and WebAssembly.
project.paragraph2: This project is open-sourced on GitHub (deployment) and GitHub (training). See the research page and paper (DOI).
project.disclaimer: WearMask is a research and demonstration system, not a medical device or diagnostic tool.

feedback.buttonTitle: Report failed cases or talk with the developer.

modal.title: Camera permission required
modal.body: To start mask detection, allow your browser to access the camera in its settings, then refresh this page.
